eps.t: A Beagle Scout Prepares / Teach a Bird to Fish
eps.o: Snoopy takes action after hearing his troop is at risk of being dissolved. The Beagle Scouts set out to earn their fishing badges.

eps.t: Homesick Sally / Red Haired Letter Day
eps.o: Sally struggles to adjust to camp—but a new friend hops into her life. Charlie Brown enlists Snoopy's help to deliver a special letter.

eps.t: To Dive or Not to Dive / Foul Weather Friends
eps.o: Peppermint Patty's fear of diving sends her Snoopy's way. The Beagle Scouts attempt to build a shelter as Sally and Naomi fight over bracelets.
Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts embark on a mission to earn their foraging badges. Charlie Brown is determined to win a "Piney" award.

eps.t: Campfire Yarns / Beagle Point or Bust
eps.o: The kids tell scary campfire stories, but Charlie Brown is lost for words. Snoopy's journal sheds light on an ill-fated canoe voyage to Beagle Point.
Snoopy encounters a new nemesis: a mosquito that won't leave him alone. Schroeder thinks the camp's official song is due for an update.

eps.t: Leave It Like You Found It / Camp Mascot
eps.o: The Beagle Scouts and the kids enjoy a hidden oasis, but their playtime upsets Linus. Charlie Brown and Snoopy compete to be camp mascot.
Linus' blanket gets snagged and unravels on a hike, leaving him frazzled. Snoopy tries to crash the kids' build-your-own-pizza night.

eps.t: Bed Heads & Beagle Care / The Great Gold Rush
eps.o: Snoopy wants the Beagle Scouts to try for the dog-care badge—by pampering him. A scavenger hunt sends the kids on a wild goose chase.
Sally feels left out when Naomi and Snoopy play ring toss. The kids write home about their best days at camp.

eps.t: Camp Crush / Counselor for a Day
eps.o: Peppermint Patty is convinced Charlie Brown has a crush on her and wants to let him down easy. Marcie is chosen to be camp counselor for a day.

eps.t: Sally's Tooth / The Chewing Gum Dilemma
eps.o: Sally loses a tooth and worries the tooth fairy won't know she's at camp. Charlie Brown's fortunate find turns into candy chaos.

eps.t: Summer Friends / Last Day of Camp
eps.o: With camp nearing its end, Sally faces saying goodbye to her new friend Naomi. Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts race to earn one last badge.
